metadata.descriptionNullable: # MAJOR UPDATE: ## I have finally finished the update. See below for what is included. Besides implementing new tables, I have also backfilled missing data from previous iterations. This NBA dataset contains player and team box scores and statistics for every NBA game from 1947 to the present. It is historical and comprehensive, updated daily. Designed for enthusiasts, analysts, and data scientists, it provides a solid foundation for exploring basketball history, player performance, and team dynamics. The dataset is updated daily with the latest results. I provide it in the .csv format for maximum accessibility: **Description of Files in the Dataset:** 1. *PlayerStatistics.csv* The centerpiece of the dataset, this file contains detailed box scores for every individual player in NBA history, game by game. 2. *TeamStatistics.csv* A complete record of team-level box scores for every game played in NBA history. 3. *PlayerStatisticsExtended.csv* This file contains all the advanced game-by-game statistic for each player in almost game since 1996 when advanced statistics records start on nba.com. It also includes all the data in PlayerStatistics.csv. Each row is an extension of the corresponding PlayerStatistics.csv row, with over 100 columns of data. 4. *TeamStatisticsExtended.csv* This is the same idea as PlayerStatisticsExtended.csv, but at a team level. 5. *PlaybyPlay.parquet* Detaild play-by-play information for almost every game since 1996, when this data collection begins. 6. *Games.csv* Comprehensive records of all NBA games, including home and away teams, game outcomes, and, where available, arena and attendance details. Recent entries include expanded data, with plans to retroactively update historical entries. 7. *LeagueSchedule24_25.csv, LeagueSchedule25_26.csv* The full schedule for the 2024–2025 and 2025-2026 NBA seasons, including game locations and times. 8. *Players.csv* Biographical information for almost every player, including height, weight, and position, enabling detailed player analysis across eras. 9. *TeamHistories.csv* A historical account of NBA franchises, tracking name changes, relocations, and expansions over the league’s history. (Note, there might be a few gaps here and there, but we are talking only missing a few games or a few players. Some of this is due to the data being unavailable on NBA.com) It took a bit of money to get all this stuff up and running on Amazon Web Services. If you would like to help support this project, I would be very grateful for any donations made here :-) Thanks to NBA.com for the underlying data.
